ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping Safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain The National and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain The National and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain School rules and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Class Leadership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
